newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Nomura repeats "buy" on Cortecs.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Nomura repeats "buy" on Cortecs.

text.p: Nomura International analyst Nick Woolf said he repeated his "buy" rating on biotechnology group Cortecs International Ltd.
Woolf estimated sales to grow by 33 percent in 1997 and by 155 percent in 1998.
He was forecasting a re-rating of the stock after key trial data on treatment for osteoporosis, which has a potential market of $800 million.

Woolf said that if the efficacy demonstrated in Phase II trials last April can be repeated in Phase II/III, then submission for a European licence and a multi-national partner could be secured within a few months.
The interim analysis of the European trial is expected later this month.
Woolf said he was expecting other good news from the company in upcoming months.

They include results of preliminary studies with oral insulin in diabetic patients, results of the Phase II trial with Pseudostat in chronic bronchitis, results of the Phase I study with Flustat, the oral influenza vaccine, results of the Phase I study with oral testosterone and the launch of the one-step osteoporosis diagnostic test.
